notes.title: Block Ops 3D: Road to BETA 🚀 Update 15 & 16 Patch!
notes.content:
We’re back with another big update! Milestones 15 (V0.096) and 16 (V0.097) brings major progress, polishing, and new features as we get closer to launch.

Milestone 15 Highlights

🎯 Training Mode (Part 1) introduced
🗺️ New Training level map
🗣️ New shopkeeper dialog
💨 Wind effects added to Training map
🎨 Updated UI menus & new UI buttons
📑 New Disconnect/Name Change/Exit window
⏳ Increased player search timer
🖼️ Improved aspect ratio scaling (backgrounds resized)
⚙️ Lag Compensation added (smoother movement for players, bots, zombies & vehicles)
📡 Improved network performance (tuned data rate)
🎥 Smoothed spectator camera in Bomb Defusal
🚀 Added match start delay to prevent join errors
📢 Steam Community Post (Roadmap + Milestone 11 & 12 changes)
🌍 Social Media post created
🐞 General bug fixes & quality updates

Milestone 16 Highlights

✅ Training Mode completed & polished
🏝️ Training Island fully detailed
⚙️ In-game settings UI updated
⏳ Loading & intro screen UI updated
🎶 Block Ops 3D Music Video – Final Edit
🔫 Increased weapon bullet ranges by 70%
🕹️ Fixed networked player teleport movement
🎯 Fixed Training Mode objective UI
🔊 Background SFX added to Training map
🚗 Tweaked vehicle radio volume
🛠️ Fixed sidewalk colliders on Large Map 2
🐞 Various bug fixes

New Official Socials:
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@zedgamedev
Facebook: https://web.facebook.com/blockops3d
Twitter/X: https://x.com/blockops3D
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@blockops3d

notes.title: 🚀 Road to Launch: Development Roadmap & Major Updates 📢
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We wanted to take a moment to reconnect with you and provide a proper update on the game’s development progress. We know it’s been quiet on the communication front lately — that’s on us — but we want to reassure you that development has [i]never[/i] stopped.[/p][p]Here’s a quick breakdown of the work that’s been done recently as well as a look at what’s coming next. We're currently marching toward launch, and these milestones are part of that journey.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]✅ [b]Milestone 11 (V0.087)[/b] – [i]Completed[/i][/h3][h3] This update focused on expanding content and improving controller accessibility:[/h3][list][*][p]🔧 Fixed issues with [b]Offline Mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🗺️ Began [b]Large Map 2 Rework (Phase 1)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ Integrated [b]War Mode[/b] into Large Map 2[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 Added [b]Controller Support (XInput)[/b] with [b]Aim Assist[/b] and [b]Controller Cursor[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🧳 Implemented [b]Inventory UI in Adventure Mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]📸 Released [b]Promotional Screenshots[/b] of the new map[/p][/*][*][p]🌄 Reworked [b]TDM Map 2 Terrain[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🐞 General Bug Fixes & Internal Testing[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]✅ [b]Milestone 12 (V0.091)[/b] – [i]Completed[/i][/h3][h3] This milestone continued the momentum with more features and polish:[/h3][list][*][p]🗺️ Continued [b]Large Map 2 Rework (Phase 2)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🧭 Integrated [b]Adventure Mode[/b] into Large Map 2[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 Added [b]Controller Support (DInput)[/b] and [b]Controller UI Buttons[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🎰 Introduced the [b]Spin Wheel Mini-Game[/b] in the lobby[/p][/*][*][p]🔫 Added [b]More Weapon Attachments[/b][/p][/*][*][p]📸 Shared additional [b]Promotional Content[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🐞 More Bug Fixes & Testing[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔜 [b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3][p]We’re ramping up again with new content, polish, and quality-of-life updates as we get closer to release. More details will be shared soon, and we’ll be posting regularly from here on out so the community stays in the loop.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and continued support. This project means the world to us, and we’re excited to show you what’s coming next![/p][p]Stay tuned,
– Zed The Developer[/p]

notes.title: We Need Your Feedback!
notes.content:
Dear Playtesters,

Thank you for taking part in the playtest of BLOCK OPS 3D! 

Your time and effort are greatly appreciated, and now we need your feedback to make the game even better.

We’ve prepared a short survey to gather your thoughts on the different game modes, gameplay mechanics, and overall experience. Whether you played for a few minutes or a few hours, your insights are incredibly valuable to us.
